description: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.DATA_METRIC_FUNCTION_REFERENCES - the readback for metric attachments: a column metric names the metric and its overload (TABLE(NUMBER) / NUMBER(38,0)), a table-level metric has an EMPTY signature, the string overload carries its length, the entity trio with the domain spelled in mixed case (Table), the fixed status cells (DISABLED/DISABLED/MEDIUM with empty USE_ROLE and EXCLUDE_TABLE_TYPES), DATA_METRIC_SCHEDULE read back as cron (minutes below an hour, hours above), SUSPEND moving one attachment's status only, the metric-name call shape listing measured objects (FULL name required - a bare name is refused), a missing object refused, and the no-argument call refused with the two accepted shapes spelled out. REF_ID and REF_ARGUMENTS are deliberately not asserted (per-attachment UUID / internal column id). Converted 1:1 from features/DataMetricReferencesTest (now retired).
